text: Okay, like I literally just told you. I don't want to pick "no longer needed". That's not why. I want to return it because I found a better deal. That's the whole point! Why can't you just take it back? This is ridiculous. That's not doing it for me. Can I just talk to someone who can actually fix this?
zh: 好的，就像我刚才告诉你的。我不想选“不再需要”。这不是原因。我想退货是因为我发现了一个更好的优惠。这才是重点！为什么你不能直接收回去？这太荒谬了。这样不行。我能和能实际解决这个问题的人谈谈吗？
